details:
Description

In VR, after joining a new world and opening the Quick Menu, then opening the Main Menu, I cannot select items on scrollable pages. This affects pages that can be scrolled up/down, such as Worlds or Friends pages. When I point at an item with the VR controller and press the trigger/click button, even a very small movement of the controller is interpreted by the game as a drag/scroll gesture. Because of this, the click/selection is not registered, and the page scrolls instead. As a result, I cannot click into worlds, friends, or other entries on scrollable pages, making the VR menu effectively unusable.

This happens consistently after entering a new world. It seems the drag/scroll threshold is too low, so normal hand tremor or slight controller movement cancels the click.

Reproduction Steps

Launch VRChat in VR with [headset/controllers].

Join a new world/instance.

Open the Quick Menu.

Open the Main Menu.

Navigate to a scrollable page, such as Worlds or Friends.

Point at an item on the page with the VR controller and press the trigger/click button.

Slightly move the controller while clicking.

Observe that the page is treated as scrolling/dragging instead of selecting the item.

Try clicking other items on the same scrollable page; they also cannot be opened.
